verdict.rationale: Codegen is an AI coding-agent platform that sends customer code and prompts to AI models, so a training opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether customer data is used for model training or whether users can opt out. The pack covers agent features, integrations, permissions, the CLI and SDK, and telemetry, but has no privacy or data-use policy.
